title: The front door's Recent lists documents you opened
goal: The new window's front door has a Recent section, but it shows only the last few captures, so a UI design or edited picture you saved yesterday cannot be reopened from there, and the app has no list of recent documents anywhere. The entry walkthrough's Recent is your recent documents.
notes: Source: rough line in queue/audits/2026-10-09-front-door.json ('Recent shows capture history ... not every document you have opened'). Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/ui-entry-wt.html step 2 ~290-300, ~360. Code: Sources/Photonz/FrontDoorView.swift ~197-204 reads capture.store.entries. No Open Recent anywhere in Sources: NSDocumentController.recentDocumentURLs is the Mac's own list if the app's documents go through it; check before building a second list. Open Recent belongs in File (placement contract).
acceptance: Saving a document and opening a new window at Next defaults shows that document in Recent, with its thumbnail and name, and clicking it opens it
Recent captures still reach the front door the way the mock draws them, or the audit says where they went and why
File > Open Recent lists the same documents, with Clear Menu
A walk saves a document, opens a new window and reopens it from Recent, green at Next defaults

Audit written under queue/audits/ with the front door beside ui-entry-wt.html step 2; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Before building: mock step 2 says Recent is 'your recent documents' and draws shots and a clip together, so documents go among captures by date rather than a second row. The app is a menu bar agent (LSUIElement) with no NSDocument, so the Mac's own recent list has nowhere to show and no dates; one list of our own feeds both the front door and File > Open Recent. Saving then clicking Recent would have opened a second window on the same file, so reopening an open file now brings its window forward.

left rough: capture cards under Recent still open on a SwiftUI tap gesture; the walk's pointer click on a document card did nothing until it became a Button (the probe window is never key), so a capture card's click is unproven by a walk. A person clicking a key front door is the ordinary case, so not filed.

Audit rough items: document/capture card action rows filed as a-recent-document-card-offers-the-mock-s-copy-pi; old packages without a preview and a saved video's preview frame stay here (no walk shows either broken).

Front door Recent lists saved/opened documents among captures with a preview picture; File > Open Recent with Clear Menu; reopening an open file brings its window forward. Flag next-recent-documents on by default in Next. Verified: front-door-recent-documents-walk green at Next defaults (pointer click on the Recent card reopens the saved project, Open Recent lists and focuses it, Clear Menu empties it), front-door-walk and design-ui-start-walk green, Scripts/test.sh 12215 tests passed. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-10-recent-documents.json. Commit 3a5cfc74.
